title: Split route-evaluator into hotpath/control-plane and add async shard-lease manager
creator: Asha Patel
description:
Background:
The current route-evaluator mixes long-running control logic (policy reconciliation, lease bookkeeping, and regional affinity state) with the request hotpath used by incoming inference requests. This coupling has caused increased lock contention and tail-latency regressions when regional state churns or when autoscaler events occur.

Goal:
1) Separate the evaluator into two orthogonal layers: a fast, minimal hotpath evaluator that answers route decisions using compact, precomputed decision tokens; and a control-plane reconciler that owns shard leases, policy horizon computation, and regional garbage collection.
2) Implement an async shard-lease manager that issues short-lived leases to hotpath nodes and refreshes leases off the hotpath to prevent synchronous waits.
3) Reduce hotpath contention and P99 latency while keeping decision correctness and deterministic fallback behavior.

Approach:
- Introduce a compact DecisionToken struct (immutable) that encodes chosen route, model-variant, expiry, and fallback-stable-hash. Tokens are produced by the control-plane reconciler and pushed into the hotpath cache.
- Implement shard-lease-manager service (single-threaded actor per region) that manages lease timers and exposes a non-blocking lease refresh channel for hotpath servers.
- Refactor policy-evaluator to run horizon computations and expensive ranking in control-plane scheduled tasks (configurable cadence). Hotpath will only consult decision tokens and an in-memory, lock-free cache.
- Add instrumentation to track token miss rates, lease refresh latencies, stale-decision counts, and hotpath lock acquisition times.

Acceptance criteria:
- Hotpath P50 and P95 unchanged or improved, P99 reduced by >=20% under synthetic regional churn load.
- DecisionToken miss rate < 1% in steady-state for our baseline 10k QPS test.
- No end-to-end correctness regressions: fallbacks must be behaviorally equivalent to current policy (validated by regression test harness).
- Rollout can be toggled per-region via feature flag.

Alternatives considered:
- Sharding the existing evaluator with per-shard locks: rejected because it only reduces contention surface but still leaves hotpath waiting on lease refreshes.
- Centralizing the policy evaluator as a remote service called synchronously: rejected due to added network dependency on hotpath path.

Risks and mitigations:
- Risk: stale tokens leading to incorrect fallbacks. Mitigation: token TTLs + conservative lease expiry and a fallback circuit-breaker that triggers a safe synchronous reconcile if token validation fails more than threshold times.
- Risk: operational complexity of shard-lease manager. Mitigation: run in single-threaded actor per region with clear healthchecks and fail-open behavior that falls back to current evaluator while we investigate.

Testing strategy:
- Unit tests for DecisionToken encode/decode, lease refresh logic, and fallback trigger thresholds.
- Integration: synthetic traffic harness that simulates region failovers, autoscaler spikes, and traffic skew to validate latency and correctness.
- Load test against staging runtime-2.4 with 10k QPS and region churn script.

Telemetry and dashboards:
- New Grafana panels: token_miss_rate, lease_refresh_p99_ms, hotpath_lock_time_ms, stale_decision_count, fallback_invocations_by_reason.
- Add alerts: token_miss_rate > 5% sustained (30m), lease_refresh_p99_ms > 200ms (5m), fallback_invocations > 100/min (5m).

Docs and runbook:
- Confluence: "Routing Modernization: Hotpath/Control Split" (link below) with design, rollout checklist, and rollback steps.
- Runbook entry for shard-lease-manager incidents including how to disable feature flag and force current evaluator.
acceptance_criteria:
- Hotpath P99 reduced by >=20% under churn.
- DecisionToken miss rate <1% steady-state.
- Regression tests show no behavioral changes in fallbacks.
- Feature-flagged rollout with per-region toggles and monitored telemetry.
rollout_plan: 1) Merge feature-gated control-plane and token generator behind feature flag. 2) Deploy shard-lease-manager to staging region; run 24h soak with synthetic churn tests. 3) Enable token emission for a single non-critical region (canary) and monitor telemetry for 1hr. 4) If stable, progressively enable for additional regions in 3x scale steps. 5) After full rollout, keep legacy evaluator in passive mode for 48h before cleanup.

2026-02-25 - Marcus Green: POC for DecisionToken and a lock-free cache implemented on branch feat/evaluator-split. Early microbench shows hotpath lock time reduced by ~35% in local harness.
2026-03-02 - Diego Ramirez (infra): Added async lease refresh channel implementation notes and non-blocking gRPC stub. Raising PR infra#5421 for deployment orchestration of shard-lease-manager.
2026-03-08 - QA (Lena Ortiz): Integration tests in staging show token_miss_rate 0.6% at 5k QPS and fallback_invocations spike during aggressive region churn. Added follow-up task to tune lease TTLs.
2026-03-12 - Marcus Green: Addressed QA feedback, tuned TTLs to 6s, updated regression harness. Opened PR serving-runtime#1987 for code review. Requesting performance sign-off before canary.
